voices.note: anonymous redactorial voice of this piska
the mishna on a priest's blemishes (44a), cited at 40b.2 (דתנן)

props.gloss_en: when the Rabbis dispute Rabbi [over 'its mouth like a pig's'], it is where its upper lip overlaps the lower
but where the lower overlaps the upper -- it is a blemish
and the incident too: the lower jaw protruded beyond the upper; Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel asked the Sages and they said: it is a blemish
[a person:] his upper lip protrudes beyond the lower, or the lower beyond the upper -- it is a blemish
regarding a person it is written 'any man of the seed of Aaron' -- a man who is equal to the seed of Aaron
but in an animal, no [it is not a blemish]
this [our incident] is where it has a bone
that [the mishna about a person] is where it has no bone
